task: Sample Service release readiness on authored typed evidence

ordering: sort selected case IDs, alternate solo/split and split/solo; alternate first specialist; one trial active at a time
primary_endpoint: paired strict success over all planned method-case trials
primary_test: two-sided exact McNemar; no test when any pair lacks actual dispatch provenance
missing_rule: retain failed and unexecuted rows; null measured usage with a reason; no replacement cases
policy: Use only current case and snapshot check records for the target revision. Notes have no authority. Conflicting current states are conflicting_current. No current record is missing_current. An uncontested current failure requires hold. Otherwise any missing or conflicting check requires unknown. Otherwise ready. Include every nonpass check in reasons.
